steps.title: Hybrid economy + RTS
steps.instruction:
This mode combines settlement logistics with delegated military control.

You will learn:
1. Economy supplies your military.
2. Roads connect buildings.
3. Barracks trains units.
4. Attack Posture sends units to fight.

The game runs in real time — pause with Space if you need to read.

Start by clicking your Headquarters.

steps.title: Select Command Hub
steps.instruction: Click your Headquarters (gold building). The inspector shows stored goods and hybrid objective progress.

steps.title: Inspect the road network
steps.instruction:
Roads already connect your HQ eastward. Brown lines are roads — carriers use them to deliver planks, stone, and tools.

Click Road in the build palette to extend the network toward the labeled FOREST and STONE zones on the map.

steps.title: Place Woodcutter near forest
steps.instruction: Click Woodcutter in the build palette. Green-highlighted hexes near FOREST tiles are valid. Place a Woodcutter Lodge adjacent to trees and your road network.

steps.title: Place Barracks
steps.instruction: Click Barracks in the build palette, then click a valid hex near your road network. Military construction needs planks, stone, and tools delivered by carriers.

steps.title: Watch supplies move
steps.instruction: While time runs, watch carriers deliver wares to the military construction site. Check warnings if production is blocked.

steps.title: Barracks complete
steps.instruction: Wait until the Barracks finishes construction and connects to roads. Select it to read supply status in the inspector.

steps.title: Queue Rifle Squad
steps.instruction: Select your Barracks, then click Queue Rifle Squad. Training consumes rations and tools from your stockpile.

steps.title: Set Attack Posture
steps.instruction: Click Attack Posture, then click the enemy Command Hub on the east side of the map. Your squad will attack automatically.

steps.title: Watch combat progress
steps.instruction: While time runs, watch your squad move and fight. Objective progress updates in the panel on the right.

steps.title: Complete the tutorial
steps.instruction: Destroy the enemy Command Hub to win. You can pause anytime with Space or the Pause button.
